21185.page_note: Oldham County EMS, run by Baptist Health for the county ambulance taxing district, provides 911 ambulance service to Oldham County. 21207.page_note: Russell County EMS answers 911 calls in Russell County and Russell County Ambulance Service holds the county's only 911 ambulance licence. A page saying it transports patients is not yet found.

21213.page_note: Franklin-Simpson County Ambulance Service (Simpson County EMS) answers 911 calls in Simpson County and holds the county's only 911 ambulance licence. A current page saying it transports patients is not yet found.
